_README: Shared golden corpus: same markdown fixtures, same expected OPEN tasks, asserted by BOTH the app parser (src-tauri/src/parser/checkboxes.rs::parse_tasks_in_note) and the MCP parser (corvux-mcp/src/conventions.rs::parse_open_tasks). Both parse with note_date=None and today fixed at 2026-06-11. Convention 0.3: a checkbox is a TASK when it has a date context (an inline 📅, a ⏰, or living in a dated note via frontmatter `date:`/daily-note filename). The DUE date (`due` below) comes only from an inline 📅 or a lone ⏰ (→ today); a checkbox that is a task only because the note carries a `date:` is a visible task with NO due date (`due` = ""). Each entry: `contains` = a distinctive fragment of the open task's text; `due` = the resolved due date (YYYY-MM-DD) or "" if none. Keep keys starting with `_` as metadata, not fixtures.
